regions.full_page: God bless you and guide you. - you and yours. I was just with Joseph J. He said had been in long distance touch with just before and - God help, us another disapointment! Well ?...? It is a problem what to do - or what it may be possible to do. One thing, which in the final will much mean much is to try again and again in time of any crisis, to keep our old heads from overmuch wrrying. At times of course this will seem impossible but God is always pleased to see us turn to him and His saints and try on. These days especially we just cannot surmise what may be ahead of us. However, that is nothing specially new, for its more or less the same story at ever turn in our earthly pilgrimage. In other words, it would seem that the great lesson Godhimself would want us to learn on that pilgrimage, is appreciation for the Life Eternal He has waiting for us, if by correspondence with His grace we begin to wean ourselves from this temporal - "momentary existance .... courage therefore ... Heroism! In God's grace are we not spouses of Jesus Crucified ...
